evidence: Directly alters core validation and chainstate architecture by eliminating multiple concurrent chainstates across src/validation.cpp, src/node/chainstate.cpp, and block storage.
rationale: Addresses the high ongoing architectural complexity and cognitive burden imposed by multiple concurrent chainstates across core validation logic. As the author notes, 'Multiple chainstates affect much more than snapshot loading: ordinary validation changes have to account for different chainstate roles, candidate sets, notifications, downloads, pruning, cache allocation, database lifetimes and locks,' creating a pervasive maintenance burden in the most critical subsystem of the codebase.
